notes.title: New Location!
notes.notes:
We added a new location to escape from... Asylum! 
Once you start game, you will have half a chance at spawning in the new map!
No more playing manor 24/7... try your luck at ASYLUM.
Extra coins have been spread throughout the map. get collecting!

notes.title: We are READY!
notes.notes: Hello everyone, the day is here. Escape The Evil is now released to the full public. Do you have what it takes to escape the evil manor from a killer psychopath!? Test your skills by unlocking secret doors, solving puzzles and reaching the final escape button.

notes.title: Escape The Evil Is Here!
notes.notes: Dominate your killer in random generated levels. Earn points by completing tasks and use them to unlock new killers. Move stealthily to avoid being hunted. Take your chance at survival in this thrilling hide-and-seek horror game launching SOON!
